notes: Method: enumerated the 2085 URLs in Lidl's advertised pages sitemap, filtered for legal keywords, fetched the 5 most relevant documents. No URL was guessed. 5 of 5 returned retrievable text, unlike Aldi's client-rendered legal pages. The online-shop AGB is a consumer purchase contract (ordering, prices, payment, withdrawal, returns). It contains no clause on automated extraction, scraping, or reuse of price/content data, and no clause expressly prohibiting it either. The only commercial clause located concerns BULK RESALE OF PURCHASED GOODS ('gewerbliche Weiterverkauf'), which is a purchasing term, not a data-reuse term. REUSE PERMISSION REMAINS UNKNOWN. Absence of a clause is not permission, and it is not prohibition. This is a legal question under German Datenbankherstellerrecht and UrhG and requires advice before any build.
